topic: Two siblings inherit their grandmother's house
text: When my sister and I found out we'd inherited Grandma's house, the weight of the moment settled in as we stood together, looking at the familiar front door. This wasn't just a house; it was a place where memories were woven into the very walls. I suggested we start by going through her things, carefully, room by room, deciding what to keep and what to let go. It felt right to honor her life and the legacy she left us, not just as heirs, but as keepers of her stories. We promised to take our time, to breathe in the essence of home, and to make decisions that would make her proud.
